Una password lunga batte una password co: A long password beats a complicated one. Here’s why, in 4 minutes.
<span class=\"pp-anim__n\" aria-hidden=\: 1 One password for everything is a key that opens every door.
2 If a site leaks its passwords, that key gets passed around.
3 A different key for each door: lose one and the others stay locked.
Luca usa la stessa password ovunque: il: Luca uses the same password everywhere: his dog’s name and the year he was born.
Un giorno il sito di un videogioco a cui: One day a video game site he had signed up to has its data stolen. The next day someone gets into his social media profile.
Apri le risposte e scopri come va a fini: Open the answers and find out how it ends.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: A They guessed the password.
Non hanno dovuto indovinare niente: la p: They didn’t have to guess anything: they already had it, taken from the data stolen from the game site.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: B They tried the stolen password on other sites, and it worked.
Proprio così. Si chiama credential stuff: Exactly. It’s called credential stuffing: people who steal passwords try them everywhere. If you only use one, one leak opens everything.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: C The social network was hacked.
Il social non c’entra: la porta l’ha ape: The social network had nothing to do with it: the reused password opened the door.
Scegli il livello: la verità è la stessa: Pick your level: the truth is the same, only the words change.
La password è come la chiave di casa: no: A password is like your house key: you don’t lend it, not even to your best friend. Only a grown-up at home knows it.
Più è lunga, più è difficile da indovina: The longer it is, the harder it is to guess. You can make one up with your grown-up by putting funny words together.
I furti di dati colpiscono siti di ogni: Data breaches hit all kinds of sites: your password can end up on a list through no fault of your own.
Se la stessa password apre più account,: If the same password opens several accounts, whoever steals it opens them all.
Una password lunga e diversa per ogni ac: A long password that is different for every account, saved in a password manager, protects you even when a site is breached.
Attacchi: forza bruta, dizionario e sopr: Attacks: brute force, dictionary and above all credential stuffing, that is trying username and password pairs stolen from another site. It works because people reuse the same credentials.
Lato utente: password uniche generate da: On the user side: unique passwords generated by a manager and, where possible, FIDO passkeys: the private key stays on the device and each passkey is bound to one site, so a fake site cannot obtain it. On the server side: slow hashes with a unique salt per password; OWASP recommends Argon2id, then scrypt, then bcrypt.
Prendi il telefono: lo facciamo insieme,: Grab your phone: let’s do it together, right now.
Apri le impostazioni dell’account email: Open your email account settings and choose “Change password”.
Crea una password con tre o più parole a: Create a password from three or more random words joined together that have nothing to do with you: no family or pet names. Don’t use the example on this page.
Se il telefono te lo propone, salvala ne: If your phone offers to, save it in the password manager, or create a passkey.
